Element.description: Represents an HTML element in the DOM tree with attributes, children, and styling

Attribute.description: Name-value pair that configures an HTML element's behavior or appearance

DOMString.description: UTF-16 text string type used throughout the Web API for text content

Document.description: Represents the entire HTML document and serves as the entry point to the DOM

Event.description: Represents an event that occurs on a DOM element such as click, input, or submit

NodeList.description: Collection of DOM nodes returned by querySelectorAll and childNodes

CSSStyleDeclaration.description: Object representing CSS property-value pairs for inline and computed styles

flow-content.description: Most elements usable in a document body — the default content model.

phrasing-content.description: Text and the elements that mark it up inline: span, a, em, strong, code.

heading-content.description: h1-h6 and hgroup, which define a section's heading.

sectioning-content.description: article, aside, nav and section, which scope headings and outlines.

embedded-content.description: Content from another resource: img, video, audio, iframe, canvas, svg, object.

interactive-content.description: Elements intended for user interaction: a with href, button, input, select, textarea, details.

metadata-content.description: Head-level elements: title, base, link, meta, style, script.

void-element.description: An element with no closing tag and no children: area, base, br, col, embed, hr, img, input, link, meta, source, track, wbr.

global-attribute.description: Valid on any element: id, class, style, title, hidden, tabindex, lang, dir, data-*, role, aria-*.

boolean-attribute.description: Presence means true; the value is irrelevant. disabled, checked, required, readonly, multiple, open.

enumerated-attribute.description: A fixed keyword set, e.g. contenteditable, draggable, loading, decoding, crossorigin.

aria-role.description: An accessibility role overriding the implicit semantics. Prefer the correct native element first.

custom-element.description: An author-defined element whose name contains a hyphen, registered with customElements.define.

form-associated.description: Participates in form submission and validation: input, select, textarea, button, output, fieldset.

replaced-element.description: Rendered from an external resource, so its intrinsic size affects layout: img, video, iframe, object.

template-content.description: Inert markup inside template, cloned into the document by script rather than rendered in place.
